subject: Archer portal: SFTP manifest ingestion & key rotation plan
messages:
From: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@acmecloud.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Archer Onboarding <onboard@archersecurity.com>
Date: 2027-08-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Archer portal onboarding + automated evidence feed

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for taking this on. We're starting Archer onboarding for AcmeCloud and would like to automate our evidence uploads to speed future revalidations. Archer supports both manual uploads and SFTP manifest ingestion; we'd prefer SFTP.

Can you confirm the following from Redwood:
- Support for a nightly SFTP ingest that consumes a CSV manifest (Archer calls it manifest_v2.1).
- Preferred key rotation cadence (we try to align with vendor KMS cycles).
- Any file layout expectations for compressed evidence (zip per control vs single bundle).

We also need a copy of Redwood's latest SOC 2 type 2 and the contact for someone who can sign the DPAA (DocuSign preferred). Attaching the Archer onboarding checklist they sent for reference.

Attachments: Archer_onboarding_checklist.pdf (pdf stub)

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 20m call if that's easier.

—Maria
Maria Garcia
Security Program Manager, AcmeCloud
maria.garcia@acmecloud.com
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@acmecloud.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>, onboard@archersecurity.com
Date: 2027-08-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Archer portal onboarding + automated evidence feed

Maria — thanks for the clear ask. We can support nightly SFTP ingest using Archer's manifest_v2.1 schema. I've attached a small sample manifest (manifest_v2.1.csv) and our suggested packaging rules. Quick summary / proposal:

- Ingest window: 02:00–03:00 PT nightly (we can shift if Acme needs a different window).
- Packaging: one zip per control-family (helps incremental ingest). We'll include SHA256 in manifest.
- Rotation: recommend monthly SSH key rotation for SFTP; if you prefer KMS-signed auth tokens we can support 90-day rotation.
- Retention: Redwood will keep evidence in Archer staging for 540 days (aligns with our retention policy) and mirror to cold archive after that.

Attached: manifest_v2.1.csv (sample), sftp-playbook-vendor-onboarding.md (playbook stub), SOC2-Type2-2026.pdf (redacted cover + report stub). For the DPAA signature, I'll loop in Ben (legal ops lead) to complete the DocuSign.

Next steps I propose:
1) Acme confirms preferred ingest window and rotation cadence.
2) Archer provides SFTP host + temp creds (we'll exchange keys via secure portal).
3) Redwood ops (Marcus + Ben) will provision the sftp user and run a one-time test ingest.

If that looks good I'll schedule the test for this week.

Best,

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of GTM Security, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai
Attachments: manifest_v2.1.csv (csv), sftp-playbook-vendor-onboarding.md (md), SOC2-Type2-2026.pdf (pdf)
From: marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>, sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-11T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Archer portal onboarding + automated evidence feed — technical plan

Folks — following Vanessa's plan, here's a concise ops playbook for the SFTP manifest ingestion and key rotation. I'll own the implementation.

Plan highlights:
- SFTP host: sftp.archersecurity.com (we'll confirm with Archer and accept their host key).
- User provisioning: create vendor account redwood_acme_{env} with forced-key-auth only; no password fallback.
- Key rotation: monthly rotation enforced. We'll store private keys in Redwood KMS and automate a rotate-and-test job. If Acme requests KMS-signed tokens instead, we can support a 90-day token TTL with revocation via KMS.
- Integrity: manifest will include filename, control_id, timestamp, SHA256(hex). On ingest, a lambda will verify checksum and reject mismatches; we'll log failures to Sentry + Console alert.
- Retention & TTL: staging 540 days, cold archive 3 years; we will tag each object with control_id and evidence_type to facilitate queries.
- DPAA: Ben, please confirm the DocuSign envelope ID and let us know if legal needs any custom clause.

Test plan (pre-prod):
1) Exchange public key with Archer; they place it in authorized_keys for the vendor user.
2) Push sample manifest + 3 zipped evidence files during the 02:00 window.
3) Verify checksums and UX in Archer portal staging.
4) Run negative test: corrupt one zip and verify our error path.

Attachments: sftp-playbook-vendor-onboarding.md (playbook), internal-runbook-snippets.txt (snippet stub)

I'll start provisioning today and will update this thread with the temp key fingerprint.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.ai
